stepTitle: Scope OTP verification to the action being authorized
acceptanceCriteria: OTP proof cannot be reused across unrelated flows. Consent submit, public booking actions, and beach booking each require matching scoped verification. Existing OTP tests pass or are updated.

findings.detail: The journal at apps/api/drizzle/meta/_journal.json references tag '0031_add_otp_verification_scope' (idx 32), but the corresponding SQL file apps/api/drizzle/0031_add_otp_verification_scope.sql does not exist. The schema in consent-schema.ts declares the 'scope' column and 'otp_verifications_scope_idx' index, but no migration will add them to the database. Deploying without this file will either fail or leave the column missing, breaking all scoped OTP functionality.

findings.summary: Consent proof test inserts OTP rows without scope — will fail against a real database
findings.detail: createConsentVerificationProof() at line 50 inserts an otpVerifications row without the 'scope' field (defaults to null). However, the consent verify endpoint at otp-routes.ts:136 now passes scope: buildConsentOtpScope(token), which makes verifyPhoneOtpCode filter for eq(otpVerifications.scope, 'consent:v1:TOKEN'). The null-scope row won't match, so the verify will return a 400 instead of the expected 200. The insert should include scope: buildConsentOtpScope(token) to match the endpoint's scoped query.

findings.summary: All database-dependent integration tests were skipped — acceptance criteria not exercised
findings.detail: TEST_DATABASE_URL was not set, so all .skipIf(!process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL) integration tests were skipped (432 skips). The 42 passes come from non-database tests. This means the scoped OTP send/verify, cross-scope rejection for consent/booking/beach, and proof consumption tests have not actually been run. The acceptance criteria require these tests to pass, but they were never executed.
